user_query: I'm a social media manager, and I want to check the availability of a username on multiple platforms. Can you check if the username 'socialmediaexpert' is available on Instagram and Wikipedia? Additionally, fetch the top memes from the 'funny' subreddit to share on our company's social media accounts.

TaskList.description: Check the availability of the username 'socialmediaexpert' on Instagram.
Check the availability of the username 'socialmediaexpert' on Wikipedia.
Fetch the top memes from the 'funny' subreddit.
